arxiv-2002-03678.title: Simulating longitudinal data from marginal structural models using the additive hazard model
arxiv-2002-03678.creator: Ruth H. Keogh, Shaun R. Seaman, Jon Michael Gran, Stijn Vansteelandt
arxiv-2002-03678.description: Abstract Observational longitudinal data on treatments and covariates are increasingly used to investigate treatment effects, but are often subject to time-dependent confounding. Marginal structural models (MSMs), estimated using inverse probability of treatment weighting or the g-formula, are popular for handling this problem.

arxiv-2105-06864.title: A Low-Power Optical Electron Switch
arxiv-2105-06864.creator: Wayne Cheng-Wei Huang, Roger Bach, Peter Beierle, Herman Batelaan
arxiv-2105-06864.description: Abstract An electron beam is deflected when it passes over a silicon nitride surface, if the surface is illuminated by a low-power continuous-wave diode laser. A deflection angle of up-to 1.2 ​ mrad 1.2\,\textrm{mrad} is achieved for an electron beam of 29 ​ μ ​ rad 29\,\mu\textrm{rad} divergence.

arxiv-2106-02247.title: The first non-static inhomogeneous exact solution in f ⁡ ( T , B ) f(T,B) gravity
arxiv-2106-02247.creator: Sebastián Nájera, Aram Aguilar, Celia Escamilla-Rivera, Roberto A. Sussman
arxiv-2106-02247.description: Abstract We examine in this paper the possibility of finding exact solutions for Teleparallel Gravity (TG) of the type of spherically symmetric Lemaître-Tolman-Bondi (LTB) dust models. We apply to the LTB metric, as obtained from the Schwarzschild solution in General Relativity, the formalism of Teleparallel Gravity in its extension to f ⁡ ( T , B ) f(T,B) models.

arxiv-2208-00932.title: Masader Plus: A New Interface for Exploring +500 Arabic NLP Datasets
arxiv-2208-00932.creator: Yousef Altaher Ali Fadel , Mazen Alotaibi Mazen Alyazidi Mishari Al-Mutairi, Mutlaq Aldhbuiub Abdulrahman Mosaibah Abdelrahman Rezk Abdulrazzaq Alhendi, Mazen Abo Shal Emad A. Alghamdi Maged S. Alshaibani Jezia Zakraoui, Wafaa Mohammed Kamel Gaanoun Khalid N. Elmadani Mustafa Ghaleb, Nouamane Tazi R
arxiv-2208-00932.description: Abstract Masader ( Alyafeai et al. 2021 ) created a metadata structure to be used for cataloguing Arabic NLP datasets. However, developing an easy way to explore such a catalogue is a challenging task. In order to give the optimal experience for users and researchers exploring the catalogue, several design and user experience challenges must be resolved.

arxiv-2502-17393.title: [RETRACTED]Evolving Form and Function: Dual-Objective Optimization in Neural Symbolic Regression Networks
arxiv-2502-17393.creator: Amanda Bertschinger, James Bagrow, Joshua Bongard
arxiv-2502-17393.description: Abstract . Data increasingly abounds, but distilling their underlying relationships down to something interpretable remains challenging. One approach is genetic programming, which ‘symbolically regresses’ a data set down into an equation. However, symbolic regression (SR) faces the issue of requiring training from scratch for each new dataset. To generalize across all datasets, deep learning techniques have been applied to SR.

arxiv-2504-14776.title: Script2Screen: Supporting Dialogue Scriptwriting with Interactive Audiovisual Generation CCS: Computing methodologies Animation CCS: Human-centered computing Interaction design process and methods
arxiv-2504-14776.creator: Zhecheng Wang, Jiaju Ma, Eitan Grinspun, Bryan Wang, Tovi Grossman
arxiv-2504-14776.description: Abstract . Scriptwriting has traditionally been text-centric, a modality that only partially conveys the produced audiovisual experience. A formative study with professional writers informed us that connecting textual and audiovisual modalities can aid ideation and iteration, especially for writing dialogues.

arxiv-2506-03860.title: Stochastic inflation as a superfluid
arxiv-2506-03860.description: Abstract We point out that inflationary superhorizon fluctuations can be effectively described by a set of equations analogous to those governing a superfluid. This is achieved through a functional Schrödinger approach to the evolution of the inflationary wavefunction, combined with a suitable coarse-graining procedure to capture large-scale dynamics.

arxiv-2507-07960.title: Spin-only dynamics of the multi-species nonreciprocal Dicke model
arxiv-2507-07960.creator: Joseph Jachinowski, Peter B. Littlewood
arxiv-2507-07960.description: Abstract The Hepp-Lieb-Dicke model is ubiquitous in cavity quantum electrodynamics, describing spin-cavity coupling which does not conserve excitation number. Coupling the closed spin-cavity system to an environment realizes the open Dicke model, and by tuning the structure of the environment or the system-environment coupling, interesting spin-only models can be engineered.

pmc-11272701.title: Comparison of robotic-assisted total knee arthroplasty: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11272701.creator: Xinyu Fu, Yiming She, Guangwen Jin, Chengri Liu, Ze Liu, Wei Li, Ri Jin
pmc-11272701.description: This study was conducted to compare the changes in different clinical scores and imaging indexes of patients who underwent robot-assisted total knee arthroplasty (RA-TKA) and manual total knee arthroplasty (M-TKA). PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library and Embase were searched according to PRISMA guidelines in June 2024. Search terms included “robot-assisted”, “manual” and “total knee arthroplasty”.

pmc-11490839.title: Acetyl-CoA carboxylase inhibition increases retinal pigment epithelial cell fatty acid flux and restricts apolipoprotein efflux
pmc-11490839.creator: Daniel T Hass, Kriti Pandey, Abbi Engel, Noah Horton, Cameron D Haydinger, Brian M Robbings, Rayne R Lim, Martin Sadilek, Qitao Zhang, Gillian A Gulette, Amy Li, Libin Xu, Jason ML Miller, Jennifer R Chao, James B Hurley
pmc-11490839.description: Lipid-rich deposits called drusen accumulate under the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) in the eyes of patients with age-related macular degeneration and Sorsby’s fundus dystrophy (SFD). Drusen may contribute to photoreceptor degeneration in these blinding diseases. Stimulating β-oxidation of fatty acids could decrease the availability of lipid with which RPE cells generate drusen.

pmc-11549179.title: Psychotherapeutische Interventionen bei Burnout – Ein Umbrella-Review und Impulse für die Therapie
pmc-11549179.creator: Sarah Kern, Lucia Jerg-Bretzke, Petra Beschoner
pmc-11549179.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). HintergrundBurnout stellt keine eigenständige medizinische Diagnose nach ICD-11 dar, jedoch leiden laut Studienlage viele Menschen daran. Dies hat auch erhebliche volkswirtschaftliche und gesundheitspolitische Konsequenzen, da Burnout oftmals mit Arbeitsunfähigkeit und erheblichen Folgeerkrankungen einhergeht. Diese Arbeit soll einen Überblick über bereits angewandte und evaluierte Therapieansätze für Burnout vorstellen und zusätzlich aufzeigen, in welchem Bereich vielversprechende, jedoch noch wenig erforschte therapeutische Unterstützungsmöglichkeiten für Betroffene liegen.MethodenSystematische Literaturrecherche von 2010 bis 2024 in PubMed und Google Scholar für ein Umbrella-Review.

pmc-13221970.title: Delirium and incident nursing home admission among people with and without dementia
pmc-13221970.creator: Markus J Haapanen, David D Ward, Ding Ma, Emily H Gordon, Kenneth Rockwood, Ruth E Hubbard
pmc-13221970.description: BackgroundDelirium is a common, preventable hospital complication and a recognised risk factor for cognitive decline, but its association with both the risk and timing of nursing home admission remains uncertain, particularly in relation to dementia.MethodsWe conducted a matched cohort study of hospitalised UK Biobank participants with linked hospital records (1997–2022).

pmc-13334791.creator: P. Ndacyayisenga, G. Mukiza, J.P. Mbonyubwabo, D. Mugisha, I. Muhimba, J.B. Hategekimana, D. Ukwishatse, F.K. Rubuga, A. Gashaija
pmc-13334791.description: SummaryBackgroundHand hygiene (HH) is a critical, cost-effective measure to prevent healthcare-associated infections. Despite its importance, global compliance among healthcare providers remains low at 38.7%. Few studies in Rwanda have examined healthcare providers’ knowledge, perception, and adherence, and factors influencing compliance remain underexplored.

pmc-13574630.title: Exploratory comparative profiling of 22 macro- and trace elements reveals disrupted elemental homeostasis in colorectal cancer tissues
pmc-13574630.creator: Juanxian Cheng, Lishan Liang, Linyu Wang, Yan Lu, Cheng Xu, Huabin Gao
pmc-13574630.description: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is associated with systemic and local alterations in element homeostasis, yet tissue-level data remain limited and inconsistent. This study quantitatively profiled 22 macro- and trace elements in paired tumorous and histopathologically confirmed adjacent non-tumorous colonic tissues from 15 CRC patients using inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS).

pmc-13642612.title: Topological Transitions at Optical Interfaces Near Reflection Singularities
pmc-13642612.creator: Yawei Tan, Xiaohui Ling
pmc-13642612.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Topological transitions of structured light at optical interfaces, particularly near singularities in reflection coefficients, hold significant potential for advanced light field manipulation. However, these phenomena remain largely unexplored beyond classical Brewster‐angle configurations. In this work, we establish a unified theoretical framework to describe topological transitions—from an ideal vortex to a deformed off‐axis vortex—near reflection singularities and provide experimental validation of the predictions.
